notes.title: A free version of Daily OVR released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32875863/9e167558c899b78dda4b4b37f186bca5f7fcaf2b.jpg[/img]

Hi,

[b]We are so glad to announce that Daily OVR free version has released![/b] We hope this free version can help VR users to solve their basic VR needs and collect more ideas from our users. [u]And we will stop the Daily OVR DEMO version. [/u]

[h3]Here are some differences:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Free version only supports up to 2 opened overlays. (Paid version can support more numbers)
[*] Limited numbers (2) of switch programs on the QuickSwitch panel. If you want to switch more programs, you have to close the overlay and reopen it.
[*] Only one entry of My Favorites
[*] Only one CustomApp 
[*] You can only bind an overlay to the RIGHT controller. (cannot bind to the left controller, HMD, tracker)
[/olist]

We hope that you can enjoy it! And if you have any issues, you could tell us via Discord or the steam forum.

Download here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153510/Daily_OVR_Free/

Discord: https://discord.gg/Apgdp5j

tags.feature: We are so glad to announce that Daily OVR free version has released!
And we will stop the Daily OVR DEMO version.

notes.title: [Update v2.4.1464] A better VR keyboard + Machine learning keyboard detection
notes.content:
[h1][Features][/h1]
[list]
[b][*] VR keyboard [/b]
We've dropped the SteamVR keyboard and made a new one. You can open it by clicking the keyboard button on the overlay toolbar. And you can bind the keyboard to any targets, e.g. world, controllers, HMD. The default position is just below the overlay.

And we found that it's a good input experience when you bind the keyboard to the HMD. You must try it out!

[previewyoutube=vWR2i5Ed7os;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][*] ML Object Detection (Experimental feature, NOT A FINAL VERSION)[/b]
[b](Warning: It only works on the NVidia display card. And it will consume some GPU power. Use it with these in mind.)
( Currently, this feature only supports HTC Vive/Vive Pro )[/b]
Sometimes you want to open the camera to find your real keyboard, mouse, and monitor. This feature is what you want. When you enable it, it starts finding your real keyboard. We will also add other object types in near feature; something likes cat, dog, your cup...etc. 

Here are quick steps to enable it.
1. Enable your SteamVR camera.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32875863/8992c56f87a05a058b5f060ddbb91a046e1a07ab.jpg[/img]

2. Open the "setting" by clicking the gear icon on the top-right side.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32875863/b236f48c191136268737595e0b3d99fb68dacfdb.jpg[/img]

3. Enable object detection
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32875863/be610843f015471e30b952c061a9b5241e66586b.jpg[/img]

4. Restart Daily OVR

5. There is a new icon - "Detect Obj". Click it to enable the detection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32875863/4b77aaf3bc461ae71605147c41fe7aa329d4907b.jpg[/img]

6. There are some hotkeys for using this feature.
  * Start/Stop object detection - Long press right controller's grip button
  * Show/Hide object detection overlays - double-click right controller's grip button
  * Locate the KYBD/Resume the detection - double-click left controller's grip button
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32875863/794a9beb46917af4f47056d1a1336cfd26137ea8.jpg[/img]

7. Enjoy it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32875863/784c65fa6fdf6159f47d96593a78ed15f7e0e067.jpg[/img]

[/list]


Please feedback us on the Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/Apgdp5j]Daily OVR Discord[/url]

notes.title: [Beta Test] The SteamVR Beta Issue Fix
notes.content:
Recently, many users who are using the [u]SteamVR Beta version (since 1.7.2) [/u] reported they are getting a severe issue - all interactions don't work anymore!

We immediately started investigating the issue. Here is our finding.

[b]In SteamVR Beta, they modified the result of the API - ComputeOverlayIntersection. We are not sure that it is a bug or they want to deprecate it. [/b]

However, our interaction implementation is highly using the API. For solving this issue, we have to find other alternatives. 

[b]Finally, we chose to implement it ourselves. Even we are still testing the solution, and we want to invite you to join the testing.[/b]

If you want to join the beta testing, please follow the steps below.

[h1]How to join the BETA branch testing:[/h1]

    Step1: go to your Steam library, right-click DailyVR and click "Properties."
    Step2: select "beta ..." from the dropdown menu. You might need to restart STEAM to download.

[h1]How to roll back to retail version:[/h1]

    Set BETAS from "beta" to "NONE."

Even though we want to make it perfect, but it's still a BETA version, some bugs might occur. Please go to our Discord channel ( https://discord.gg/Apgdp5j ) or STEAM community to feedback the issue.

tags.bug: In SteamVR Beta, they modified the result of the API - ComputeOverlayIntersection. We are not sure that it is a bug or they want to deprecate it.

tags.feature: Finally, we chose to implement it ourselves. Even we are still testing the solution, and we want to invite you to join the testing.

notes.title: [Update v2.4.1295] Multiple CustomApps, CustomApp QuickSwitch and more!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875863/4581aaa78f5880fa27b03ec4271d0815603542a8.png[/img]

https://youtu.be/kzRB_K_4-jE

It's a fantastic time! We are releasing the new major version!

[h1]New features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Multiple CustomApps (up to 5)
[*] CustomApp QuickSwitch
[*] Other improvements and fixes
[/list]


[h1]Multiple CustomApps (up to 5)[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875863/1ed9117a84f646d5be101bb464e85d4ecfc1e9ed.png[/img]

Almost everyone needs more overlays (including us). It's not an easy thing and relates to several performance issues and limitations. If we want to provide this feature, we must do many performance tuning works. After long time hard-working, we've finally solved the most severe performance issue. Even we knew it's not the end of performance tuning, but it works much better than before.

However, this feature highly depends on your PC performance. If you feel a bad performance, you could set the FPS rate to low or close some overlays.

[h1]CustomApp QuickSwitch[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875863/4581aaa78f5880fa27b03ec4271d0815603542a8.png[/img]

When we use multiple overlays, we still felt not so convenient for switching programs. We thought that there must be a better way for effectively changing programs. That's why we created QuickSwitch.

QuickSwitch provides several features:

[list]
[*] [b]Program List (of course)[/b]

     You can select a program on the program list.

[*] [b]One History[/b]

     You can quickly go back to the previous program.
 
[*] [b]My Favorites[/b]
 
     You can save the frequently used program to My Favorites.
[/list]

[h1]Other improvements and fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Now the overlay would lock the keyboard input focus.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875863/2631d47857d85bb5f40f8d0758fd0c94b27a2610.png[/img]

In the previous version, if you enable the keyboard and incautiously move the controller's laser to other overlays, your focus would be lost because of mouse pointer movement. It may irritate you. 

Now if you enable the keyboard, DailyVR would prevent any other inputs from the controllers. We hope that It would help you to use the keyboard.

[*] [b]Supported "Desktop" and "Monitors."[/b]
Many users told us they want to mirror "Desktop" or even more, mirror monitor. Now we support it.

[*] [b]More transparent and smaller main panel and DailyVR icon [/b]
Many users complained that the main panel and DailyVR icon are too big or should be more transparent. We made some adjustments.

[*] [b]Fixed the "missing phone call notification" bug[/b]
Now you can correctly get phone call notification from DailyVR mobile app.

[*] [b]Performance improvements[/b]
We made some performance improvements by using other techniques. Now it's better. However, there still are many performance tuning to-do tasks.

[/list]

We are looking forward to your feedback!

Our Discord Channel: https://discord.gg/Apgdp5j

notes.title: [Join the BETA] v2.3.1194 - Multiple CustomApps, Channel Switch for CustomApp and more!
notes.content:
The next update is a major update which includes many significant features. We decided to release a BETA version first for collecting feedback.

This BETA includes:
[list]
[*] 5 CustomApps 
Now you can open 5 CustomApps. Why 5? Because too many overlays drop your performance and experience. We think 5 overlays may fit most your needs. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875863/76677496f8c46e35357c4682bdc92d9d04906c40.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875863/a0f617d10df1e3e64164b0fe80044a3338cc15f0.gif[/img]
[*] Channel Switch for CustomApp
5 CustomApp may not satisfy you enough. So we've implemented a fantastic feature - Channel Switch for CustomApp. You can quickly and easily switch programs by using the Channel Switch feature.  
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875863/d4d8990227b6de75658545c2263b6d16ea88ff62.gif[/img]
[*] Supported "Desktop" and "Monitors."
Many users told us they want to mirror "Desktop" or even more, mirror monitor. In fact, in the previous version, we still had some performance issues of the screen mirror technique. That's the reason we cannot support this feature before. Now we achieved a significant performance improvement. We immediately added this feature.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875863/e96b41a34295b51433ea4d0057928fff522215a7.gif[/img]
[/list]

We haven't finished some useful features in this version. Here are some features we are still working on:
[list]
[*] My favorites for Channel Switch
[*] Focus lock for keyboard input
[/list]

Even though we want to make it perfect, but it's still a BETA version, some bugs might occur. Please go to our Discord channel ( https://discord.gg/Apgdp5j ) or STEAM community to feedback the issue.


[h1]How to join the BETA branch testing:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Step1: go to your Steam library, right-click DailyVR and click "Properties"
[*] Step2: Enter the access code.
[*] Step3: select "beta ..." from the dropdown menu. You might need to restart STEAM to download.
[/list]
[b]Beta access code: JoinDailyVRBetaTesting[/b]
[Note: You will lose all your custom settings if you change to beta branch.]


[h1]How to roll back to retail version:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Step1: [b][u] Uninstall DailyVR beta first [/u][/b]
[*] Step2: Set BETAS from "beta" to "NONE"
[*] Step3: Install DailyVR
[/list]

notes.title: [Update v2.3.1142] Better keyboard position and a way to disable the gesture
notes.content:
This update added two new features.
 [list]
[*] Better keyboard position
[*] A way to disable the mode-changed gesture
[/list]

[h1]Better keyboard position[/h1]
for improving keyboard experience, we've made some position adjustment. By different attached target of overlays (world, controller, headset), it will show at different positions.

[h1]A way to disable the mode-changed gesture[/h1]
Many users mentioned that it's annoying for triggering mode change when they are waving their hands on VRChat. Now you have a way to disable the mode-changed gesture. Just hide the main panel or hide the DailyVR logo, then you disable the mode-changed gesture functionality.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875863/8d09763dbd7ab50300e02c286d52caa2f66d118d.png[/img]

notes.title: [FIXED] [Temporary Workaround] DailyVR for android cannot notify phone call and SMS
notes.content:
[h1](Updated: Good news! We've passed the review after the workaround news posted.
You don't need to install the local build. You can download it from google play directly. )[/h1]

Hi DailyVR users,

First of all, we would like to apologize for this issue. If you’ve used our DailyVR for android recently, you will find that you cannot receive any phone call or SMS notifications. Here we would like to talk about the reason, provide a workaround, and what we will do next.

[h1]Why?[/h1]
The main reason is Google changed their permission policy and they don’t accept our SMS functions is “core functionality.”  Even we’ve tried several times to fit their system, but they always rejected. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875863/8230f125c94a44ba83dc5de17bcc6b3eca874145.png[/img]

[h1]A short term workaround[/h1]
After several attempts, we decided to provide our users with a short-term solution to install the local APK file directly. 
You should uninstall the google play version first. And then install the local APK. The phone call and SMS notifications are running well in the local build.

Here are the installation steps
1.	Download the local build
2.	Uninstall the google play build
3.	Install the local build

Here is the download link
[url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/25v14lmae7cexrz/DailyVR_1.0.1017_201904241106.apk?dl=0]download the local build [/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875863/d61c5bb6418e752be0892a382e2370b33e8f1a5d.png[/img]

And if we pass Google play review in the future, you should uninstall the local build first.

[h1]What will we do next?[/h1]
We are trying using other mechanisms to get SMS notification. And we believe that this method should be able to pass the review successfully. 

In the meantime, if you want to use the full functionality of dailyVR for Android, please download the local build to use.

[b]We will fix this problem as soon as possible. Please continue to support us.[/b]

tags.bug: DailyVR for android cannot notify phone call and SMS

notes.title: [New feature][Coming soon] Support one more controller setting
notes.content:
In next update, we will support different controller button settings for input mode.

This is a temporary solution, mainly for some games that use the same trackpad button to play the game, the situation may make users feel troubled. Especially for VRChat users.

This setting is only for Vive and Windows MR users currently. How about Oculus users? No worries! We provide a better configuration for you.

1. Default 
Trackpad left side is mouse left button, right side is mouse right button

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875863/1bc9e106e1c192d04772ae190d7aedd272dd384d.jpg[/img]

2. Type 1 
Trigger is mouse left button, side button is right button

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32875863/e002160f88b95f6ef6a676aca518e1b04ff49654.jpg[/img]

In the future, we plan to support STEAMVR Input. Users can configure the buttons as they like.

Looking forward to next update!
